welcomeScatteredHint: Stow them in one place: duplicates merged, broken links found
browseNoSkillsYetBody: Add skills from GitHub, a website, or a folder on your Mac.
browseNoSearchResultsHint: Check the spelling or try a new search.
importReplaceOwnCopy: {agent} has its own copy at {path} (not a link), and replacing won't touch it. Merge the copies in My Skills first.
importReplaceMacOnly: Replacing an existing skill is only supported on macOS for now
importReplaceTrashFailed: Couldn't move the old version to the Trash, so nothing was replaced:
importReplaceTrashNote: Adding will replace these and move the old ones to the Trash:
importReplaceLinkOnly: Only the link is moved; what it points to stays
importReplacedAt: Replaced the old version in {place}. The old one is in the Trash.
importAddedReplacedNames: {added, plural, one {Added # skill} other {Added # skills}} ({replaced} replaced, old versions in the Trash): {p1}
importChangedSinceConfirm: {name} in {place} changed after you chose to replace it, so it wasn't replaced.
importChangedSinceConfirmNote: Compare again, and choose Replace if you still want to.
importReplaceUnreadable: {path} can't be read in full, so there's no way to tell whether it changed before replacing. It can't be replaced.
importReplaceOldKeptAt: The old version wasn't deleted. It's kept at {paths}.
importReplaceLinkNotRestored: {path} couldn't be restored to its original link (it pointed to {to}). The old link is in the Trash.
tidyProjectOnly: {name} is now used only in its project.
tidyCollected: {name} has been added to My Skills.
tidyLinksKept: Kept the global links for {name}; this issue will no longer be reported.
supportAppDataHint: The folder with settings, records and logs
supportDiagnosticsHint: Version, detected agents and recent errors. No skill contents or credentials.
supportReportIssueHint: Open a GitHub issue and attach your diagnostic info
supportPreviewBody: This is only copied to the clipboard, never uploaded automatically. Remove anything you'd rather not share before sending it.
supportDiagnosticsCopiedPaste: Diagnostic info copied. Paste it into the Diagnostics field of the issue.
supportDataFileRecovered: {file} was damaged and has been reset. The original was kept as {backup}.
secFindingRemotePipe: Downloads a remote script and runs it directly
secFindingRemotePipeDetail: The content is fetched from the internet and handed straight to a shell or interpreter, so this Mac can't check what it actually does. Make sure the source is trustworthy, and preferably download and read it before running it.
secFindingRemoteDownloadRun: Downloads a file and then runs it
secFindingRemoteDownloadRunDetail: A remote file is saved locally and then run, and the downloaded content wasn't checked. Make sure the source is trustworthy and read the file first.
secFindingReverseShell: Connects a shell on this Mac to a remote address
secFindingReverseShellDetail: This is a reverse-shell pattern that lets someone remote run commands on this Mac. Don't run it unless you know exactly why it's there.
secFindingEncodedExec: Decodes content and runs it directly
secFindingEncodedExecDetail: What runs is encoded, so you can't see what it does. Decode and read it before deciding.
secFindingBidiChars: Text contains characters that reorder how it displays
secFindingBidiCharsDetail: Bidirectional control characters make text display differently from what it contains and can hide instructions. Check what this line really says.
secFindingInvisibleCharsDetail: Zero-width or tag characters can't be seen but are read by the agent, and can hide instructions. Check this line.
secFindingHiddenCommentDetail: HTML comments are invisible when rendered, but the agent still reads them. Make sure you want the agent to follow what's in the comment.
secFindingIgnoreInstructions: Tells the agent to ignore earlier instructions
secFindingIgnoreInstructionsDetail: This kind of wording makes the agent stop following rules set by you or the system. Check whether it's only explaining, not instructing.
secFindingConcealFromUser: Tells the agent to hide actions from you
secFindingConcealFromUserDetail: A skill shouldn't ask the agent to act without telling you. Check what this text is for.
secFindingBypassConfirmation: Asks to skip confirmations or permission checks
secFindingBypassConfirmationDetail: Skipping confirmations lets the agent act without you knowing. Check whether it's really needed.
secFindingLeakContext: Asks to send the conversation or context elsewhere
secFindingLeakContextDetail: Conversations and system prompts can contain private information. Check where it would go and why.
secFindingSecretInChat: Asks you to paste a key into the chat
secFindingSecretInChatDetail: Keys pasted into a conversation stay in its history. Use an environment variable or the Keychain instead.
secFindingReadCredentials: Reads private keys or credential files
secFindingReadCredentialsDetail: Reads SSH private keys, cloud credentials, or Keychain items. Check why it needs them and where they're used.
secFindingCredentialUpload: Reads credentials and sends them to an external address
secFindingCredentialUploadDetail: A private key or credential is sent over the network as request content. Don't run it unless you're sure this is intended.
secFindingSecretEnvUpload: Sends a secret variable to an external address
secFindingSecretEnvUploadDetail: A secret from an environment variable is included in a request body. Make sure the destination is trustworthy and really needs it.
secFindingWipeHome: Deletes files on a large scale
secFindingWipeHomeDetail: It deletes your home folder or system folders, which may be unrecoverable. Don't run it unless you fully understand the consequences.
secFindingPersistence: Changes login items or shell configuration
secFindingPersistenceDetail: The change takes effect every time you log in or open a terminal. Check what it changes and how to undo it.
secFindingEmbeddedSecret: A file contains what looks like a real key
secFindingEmbeddedSecretDetail: A key written in a file leaks whenever the skill is shared or synced. Consider revoking it.
secFindingLinkOutside: A link points outside the skill folder
secFindingLinkOutsideDetail: The agent may read files outside the skill through this link. Check where it points.
secFindingSpecialFile: Contains special files such as pipes or devices
secFindingSpecialFileDetail: Skills normally don't need files like this. Check what it's for.
secFindingUsesNetworkDetail: Scripts or steps make network requests.
secFindingHasScriptsDetail: The agent may run these scripts.
secFindingHasBinary: Contains programs that can't be checked
secFindingHasBinaryDetail: Compiled programs can't be checked. Make sure the source is trustworthy.
secFindingNeedsAdminDetail: Some commands run with sudo and change the system as an administrator.
secFindingUnknownDetail: This result comes from newer check rules. Check again to refresh it.
secStaleNote: Files have changed. Showing the last result.
secUnknownNote: The folder couldn't be read or changed while it was being read, so the result can't be verified.
secStripWarning: {count, plural, one {# Security Warning} other {# Security Warnings}}
secDisclaimer: Checked offline on this Mac. Not a guarantee of safety.
secExternalTitle: Remote content that would run, not checked
secMaybeExample: This may be an example or a quote in documentation. Please check.
secWeakEvidence: The evidence is limited. Please check.
secNoFindings: Nothing That Needs Attention Was Found
secFailPermission: No permission to read the folder
secFailChanged: The content changed after the check
tidyNoteSecurityHighRisk: Serious risks found by the local check. Once you've confirmed one is fine, mark it as reviewed.
tidyNoteSecurityWarning: Things worth a look found by the local check. Once you've confirmed one is fine, mark it as reviewed.
tidyNoteSecurityUnfinished: These skills couldn't be fully checked, so they can't be treated as risk-free.
secAddConfirmTitle: {count, plural, one {# skill has} other {# skills have}} high risk or weren't fully checked
secAddConfirmBody: Review their check results before adding them.
secUpdateUnchecked: New version couldn't be fully checked
libraryUpdateSecurityHold: The new version's security check needs your review first
importPlaceProjectDetail: Put inside a project so it only applies there
importProjectAgentSubtitle: Placed in the folder they read in the project
importProjectSourceLocal: Source recorded as {path}. Project skills aren't included in updates yet.
importProjectSourceWebsite: Source recorded as {site}. Project skills aren't included in updates yet.
importProjectSourceGitHub: Source recorded as {repo} ({commit}). Project skills aren't included in updates yet.
importProjectReplaceOwnCopy: The copy in {dir} is a folder, not a link, and replacing won't touch it. Remove it in Finder first, or uncheck {agents} in Who Can Read.
importProjectSymlinkPermission: Multiple folders are needed, but Windows denied creating a symbolic link. Turn on Developer Mode, or only select agents that read the same folder.
importProjectDirectoryOutside: {dir} points outside the project. Choose a skill folder inside the project.
deleteProjectLocationChanged: The project skill moved. Rescan the project before deleting it.
projectInvalidFolder: Choose an existing project folder other than your home folder or a root directory.
settingsAutoCheckAppUpdatesHint: When on, checks GitHub for a new version in the background each time the app starts and once a day after that. When off, the app only goes online when you click Check for Updates….
deleteBodyOutsideShort: The original is outside skill folders and will be moved to the Trash in full.
deleteOutsideHint: Outside skill folders. Make sure this folder is not used elsewhere.
deleteAffectedAgentsSingle: {count, plural, one {1 Agent will lose access} other {These {count} Agents will lose access}}
deleteGlobalLinkWarning: After removing the global link, {agents} won't read it in any project.
deleteAffectedAgentsBatch: {count, plural, one {1 Agent will be affected} other {These {count} Agents will be affected}}
deleteBodyTrashWithLinks: {count, plural, one {The original will be moved to the Trash, and 1 link pointing to it will also be removed.} other {The original will be moved to the Trash, and {count} links pointing to it will also be removed.}}
deleteBodyBatchWithLinks: {count, plural, one {The originals will be moved to the Trash, along with the link that points to them.} other {The originals will be moved to the Trash, along with the {count} links that point to them.}}
deleteBodyOutsideWithLinks: {count, plural, one {The original is outside skill folders and will be moved to the Trash in full, and 1 link pointing to it will also be removed.} other {The original is outside skill folders and will be moved to the Trash in full, and {count} links pointing to it will also be removed.}}

importSourceClawHub: Source recorded as ClawHub: {repo}. Automatic updates aren't supported yet.
importProjectSourceClawHub: Source recorded as ClawHub: {repo}. Project skills aren't included in updates yet.
